commands.name: chooser
commands.description: Model chooser: picks the model and effort for each prompt (on, off; reset makes it ask again)
commands.output: Model chooser: off in every session.

commands.name: upgrader
commands.description: Prompt upgrader: improves substantial prompts with a short question panel (on, off)
commands.output: Prompt upgrader: off in every session.

children: No prompt is being upgraded. Long new prompts open this panel; start one with ?? to ask for it, or with !! to skip it.

script: $.ui.ask(Debugging or design work: run it on Opus · Extra?) → "Opus · Extra (recommended)"
tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
/chooser → Model chooser: off in every session.
/upgrader → Prompt upgrader: off in every session.
